A fork of level3tjg's BetterCCBrightness.

Adds more controls to the expanded brightness module in Control Center.

* toggle auto-lock & auto-brightness.
* reduce white point with an intensity slider.
* set Night Shift strength with a slider.
* show each brightness slider's level as a percentage.
* show the package icon after install.

* move to the com.cysxl package id, replacing level3tjg's BetterCCBrightness.

Changes from level3tjg's BetterCCBrightness:
* build for roothide.
* draw the level as a percentage on every brightness slider.
* close the expanded module with a swipe up from the bottom.
